mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is trending upward, or the Rank IC for the CPI trend signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, which typically leads to stronger economic growth and inflationary pressures, causing the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the t-test for the return difference between triggered and non-triggered periods has p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which typically leads to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is growing, or the Rank IC for the PAYEMS signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1700 thousand units, it signals a strong housing market and robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1700, or the Rank IC for the HOUST signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates a monetary tightening cycle in response to high inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP growth rate (derived from GDPC1) falls below 1.0% annualized, it signals a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% annualized, or the Rank IC for the GDPC1 signal is below 0.03.
